from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from beanie import init_beanie
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pymongo import AsyncMongoClient
from models import Book

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    client = AsyncMongoClient("mongodb://localhost:27017", tz_aware=True)
    await init_beanie(database=client.appdb, document_models=[Book])
    yield
    await client.close()

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)
files.models.py:
from beanie import Document
from pydantic import Field

class Book(Document):
    title: str
    author: str
    year: int
    genres: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    class Settings:
        name = "books"
files.schemas.py:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str
    author: str
    year: int
    genres: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

class BookUpdate(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = None
    author: str | None = None
    year: int | None = None
    genres: list[str] | None = None

class BookRead(BaseModel):
    id: str
    title: str
    author: str
    year: int
    genres: list[str]

    model_config = {"from_attributes": True}

import json
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from main import app

# Fixed invalid ObjectId for 404 tests
INVALID_ID = "000000000000000000000000"

# Sample book payload used for creation
BOOK_PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "The Test Book",
    "author": "Jane Doe",
    "year": 2023,
    "genres": ["fiction", "mystery"]
}


def create_book(client: TestClient) -> str:
    """Create a book via the API and return its id."""
    resp = client.post("/books", json=BOOK_PAYLOAD)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Setup failed, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    data = resp.json()
    return data["id"]


def delete_book(client: TestClient, book_id: str) -> None:
    """Delete a book via the API – ignore 404 (used for cleanup)."""
    client.delete(f"/books/{book_id}")


def test_create_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        resp = client.post("/books", json=BOOK_PAYLOAD)
        assert resp.status_code == 201
        data = resp.json()
        # Verify all fields are present and correct
        assert data["title"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["title"]
        assert data["author"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["author"]
        assert data["year"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["year"]
        assert data["genres"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["genres"]
        assert isinstance(data["id"], str)
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, data["id"])


def test_list_books():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        book_id = create_book(client)
        resp = client.get("/books")
        assert resp.status_code == 200
        books = resp.json()
        # There should be at least one book and it must contain the one we added
        assert any(b["id"] == book_id for b in books)
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, book_id)


def test_get_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        book_id = create_book(client)
        resp = client.get(f"/books/{book_id}")
        assert resp.status_code == 200
        data = resp.json()
        assert data["id"] == book_id
        assert data["title"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["title"]
        assert data["author"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["author"]
        assert data["year"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["year"]
        assert data["genres"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["genres"]
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, book_id)


def test_get_book_404():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        resp = client.get(f"/books/{INVALID_ID}")
        assert resp.status_code == 404
        assert resp.json()["detail"] == "Book not found"


def test_update_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        book_id = create_book(client)
        update_payload = {"title": "Updated Title", "year": 2025}
        resp = client.put(f"/books/{book_id}", json=update_payload)
        assert resp.status_code == 200
        data = resp.json()
        assert data["id"] == book_id
        # Updated fields
        assert data["title"] == update_payload["title"]
        assert data["year"] == update_payload["year"]
        # Unchanged fields remain the same
        assert data["author"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["author"]
        assert data["genres"] == BOOK_PAYLOAD["genres"]
        # Cleanup
        delete_book(client, book_id)


def test_update_book_404():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        update_payload = {"title": "Should Not Exist"}
        resp = client.put(f"/books/{INVALID_ID}", json=update_payload)
        assert resp.status_code == 404
        assert resp.json()["detail"] == "Book not found"


def test_delete_book():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        book_id = create_book(client)
        resp = client.delete(f"/books/{book_id}")
        assert resp.status_code == 204
        # Verify it is really gone
        get_resp = client.get(f"/books/{book_id}")
        assert get_resp.status_code == 404


def test_delete_book_404():
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        resp = client.delete(f"/books/{INVALID_ID}")
        assert resp.status_code == 404
        assert resp.json()["detail"] == "Book not found"
